audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads EVEN at 6/10 on a 44.27% win rate, and the chart gives Singed levels 2 and 3 while whys[0] through whys[2] describe those exact levels as Swain's window.
audit.why: 44.27% over 131 games is a losing lane, not an even one. The packet chart (Swain / Swain / Swain / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed) matches the prose on every row: Swain owns the pre-Fling and pre-ultimate stretch, and Singed takes over from Insanity Potion onward. The mirror audit already moved its chart to that same packet read as one group.
audit.corrected: diff HARD at 7/10; rows 0, 1, 2 to Swain and row 4 to Singed, in matched pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is written as a vague move-speed and sustain problem with no cooldown and no mechanism.
audit.why: Insanity Potion is a 100-second ultimate and the reason it flips the lane is specific: it makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds. Against a champion whose entire pattern is Ravenous Flock fragments plus Demonic Ascension drain, that is the single most important number and mechanic in the matchup, and the page never states it.
audit.corrected: 100s cooldown, and the reason: the trail carries Grievous Wounds while it is active.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions healing reduction, and nothing states that Fling roots you if it lands you in Mega Adhesive.
audit.why: The _missing-interactions entry for this matchup is exactly this: 'Singed applies Grievous Wounds via Insanity Potion (R) — your sustain (Ravenous Flock (P)) is halved once it lands, so trade before it applies.' Separately, Riot's Fling text: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' So the combo is Mega Adhesive placed behind him, then a 125-range Fling into it — the root is conditional on the goo, which tells you where not to stand.
audit.corrected: Toggle Demonic Ascension before the trail touches you, never inside it; and watch for Mega Adhesive placed behind Singed, because that is what turns Fling from a flip into a root.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (E text, range 125, cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8; W range 1000)

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling appears in four fields as 'His flip. Root/dodge it.' with no range and no cooldown.
audit.why: Fling is 125 range on a 10s rank-1 cooldown. 125 is melee-plus — he has to be on top of you — and 10 seconds is a countable window against your 12s Nevermove. The page is built entirely around tracking this ability and never says what it costs him.
The packet's suspectName on 'His Insanity Potion' in content.mid is a false positive — that is the real ultimate name, flagged only by edit distance against the lowercased string.

edits.after: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — your drain and fragment healing are cut the moment the trail touches you, and the lane flips here.
